CREATE TABLE personal_teacher (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    teacher_profile_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    language VARCHAR(35) NOT NULL,
    communication_style VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    pedagogy_profile VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    hint_policy VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    intervention_mode VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (version > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(teacher_profile_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(language) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(communication_style) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(pedagogy_profile) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(hint_policy) <> ''),
    CHECK (btrim(intervention_mode) <> '')
);
